steps.title: Open the dashboard
steps.narration: Trendora opens straight to its daily dashboard, with a live status badge and a health banner right at the top of every page.
steps.point_out: The badge reads "Ready" and the green banner underneath confirms today's board is current — both check in with the backend before showing anything.

steps.title: Open Data Manager
steps.narration: A single click from the sidebar takes you to Data Manager, where the app tracks exactly how much price history and how many daily snapshots it has on hand.
steps.point_out: The Dataset coverage panel shows real counts — symbols, trading days, snapshot dates, and any backfill gaps — never placeholder numbers.

steps.title: Choose a backfill job
steps.narration: In the "Start a fetch / backfill job" panel, switch the job kind to Backfill snapshots — the date range is already pre-filled to the data's current gap.
steps.point_out: No guesswork needed: the form already knows which dates need attention.

steps.title: Run the backfill
steps.narration: Clicking Start kicks off the backfill immediately — no scripts or terminal needed.
steps.point_out: The Job progress panel appears right away with a real breakdown — calendar days, days already snapshotted, and non-trading days — plus a live "updated Ns ago" heartbeat that keeps ticking for as long as the job runs.

steps.title: Confirm the status badge never breaks
steps.narration: Reloading the page proves everything survives the round trip — and, importantly, that an everyday backfill job never falsely flips the top status badge to "Backend unavailable" anymore.
steps.point_out: The badge still reads "Ready," exactly as before the job started — that stability is what this iteration fixed.
